text: {"assertions":["An off-by-one day bug was identified and fixed in ui/components/DatePicker.tsx on 2026-04-14.","The date picker bug only occurred for records with non-ASCII names.","The bug could be reproduced by selecting the first of the month and reopening the date picker.","The root cause was a mutable default argument that was being shared across multiple function calls.","The bug's symptom was a selected date value appearing one day behind the displayed label.","The fix involved changing the default to empty and building the value dynamically per call in PR #1031.","The fix was implemented on the branch fix/off-by-one-day-1.","The fix improved p99 latency from 1.3 seconds to 503 milliseconds."]}
